series.name: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)
series.notes: The only Eaton small-UPS family with a full numeric A/F code table in the manual. Applies ONLY to 6-20 kVA. The 9E 1-3kVA manual has a DIFFERENT and partly conflicting code set (e.g. it has F007/F500/F308/F806/F208/F613/F816 but no A007/A10A/A806/A802/AC20) - see series eaton-9e-1-3k and CONFLICTS. F304 also differs in wording: 'Unbalanced capacitor bank' here vs 'DC Bus unbalanced' on 1-3kVA.

title.ur: A007 Fans blocked / pankha band

meaning.en: One or more cooling fans are blocked or have stopped, so the UPS is overheating.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada cooling fan band ya kharaab hai, jis ki wajah se UPS garmi se bhar raha hai.

causes.en: Dust or debris blocking the fan intake or exhaust grille.
causes.ur: Fan ke intake ya exhaust grill par dhool ya mochir ki gaddi lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Fan motor has failed or the fan is jammed mechanically.
causes.ur: Fan ka motor kharab ho gaya ya fan mechanically atak gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait 5 minutes before touching the fan area.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur fan area chhoone se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Suck out dust from the fan intake and exhaust grille with a brush or vacuum cleaner.
solutions.ur: Fan ke intake aur exhaust grill ki dhool brush ya vacuum cleaner se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC bus voltage with a multimeter; if the fan is dead and the bus reads near 0 Vdc, replace the fan module.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC bus voltage maarein; agar fan mar chuka hai aur bus 0 Vdc ke qareeb hai to fan module replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A107 Cable connection error / wiring ghalat

meaning.en: The input wiring is wrong, most often line and neutral swapped at the input terminal block.
meaning.ur: Input wiring ghalat hai, aksar input terminal block par line aur neutral aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Line and neutral conductors reversed at the input terminal block.
causes.ur: Input terminal block par line aur neutral conductors aapas mein badle hue hain.

causes.en: Input cable not fully tightened on the terminal, causing an open or loose connection.
causes.ur: Input cable terminal par poori tarah kasa nahi, connection khula ya dhila ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the input breaker OFF, then use a multimeter or a non-contact voltage tester to identify live and neutral.
solutions.ur: Input breaker OFF karein, phir multimeter ya non-contact voltage tester se live aur neutral pehchanein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the input cable with correct polarity and torque the terminal screws firmly.
solutions.ur: Input cable theek polarity par dobara lagayein aur terminal screws ko mazbooti se kheench lein.

solutions.en: Check earth continuity (<1 ohm) between the chassis earth terminal and the panel earth bar.
solutions.ur: Chassis earth terminal aur panel earth bar ke darmiyan earth continuity (1 ohm se kam) check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A10A Unbalanced input voltages (3-phase input)

meaning.en: On a three-phase input the three phase-to-neutral voltages differ too much from each other.
meaning.ur: Teen phase input par teen phase-to-neutral voltages aapas mein bohat zyada farq se hain.

causes.en: Utility supply or upstream generator is producing unbalanced phase voltages.
causes.ur: Utility supply ya upstream generator unbalanced phase voltages bana raha hai.

causes.en: One phase conductor is loose, has a high-resistance joint, or a phase fuse has blown.
causes.ur: Kisi aik phase ka conductor dhila hai, us par high-resistance joint hai, ya phase fuse ud chuka hai.

causes.en: Load is heavily single-phase on one leg of a three-phase supply.
causes.ur: Teen phase supply par load kisi aik leg par zyada single-phase hai.

solutions.en: Measure all three line-to-neutral voltages and all three line-to-line voltages with a clamp multimeter or DMM.
solutions.ur: Teenon line-to-neutral aur teenon line-to-line voltages clamp multimeter ya DMM se maarein.

solutions.en: Tighten all phase connections and check each phase fuse in the upstream distribution board.
solutions.ur: Sab phase connections kheench lein aur upstream distribution board ka har phase fuse check karein.

solutions.en: If the supply itself is unbalanced, ask the utility or generator owner to correct it before running the UPS.
solutions.ur: Agar supply hi unbalanced hai to UPS chalane se pehle utility ya generator owner se usay theek karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A806 E.P.O control active (emergency power off)

meaning.en: The remote Emergency Power Off input is active, so the UPS has been driven to a shut-down state.
meaning.ur: Remote Emergency Power Off input active hai, is liye UPS ko shutdown state par le aaya gaya hai.

causes.en: The EPO wall switch or contact has been pressed by someone, possibly accidentally.
causes.ur: EPO wall switch ya contact kisi ne press kar diya hai, shayad ghalti se.

causes.en: The EPO circuit-breaker in the EPO wiring loop has tripped or been left open.
causes.ur: EPO wiring loop ka EPO circuit-breaker trip ho gaya hai ya khula chhoda gaya hai.

causes.en: Building fire-alarm or BMS contact wired into the EPO input has closed.
causes.ur: Building fire-alarm ya BMS contact jo EPO input se juri hai woh band ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Do not reset the UPS yet. Go and find out why EPO was activated.
solutions.ur: Abhi UPS reset na karein. Pehle dekhein ke EPO activate kyun hua.

solutions.en: With the UPS in maintenance bypass, measure the EPO terminal pair; it must read open (no continuity) for normal running.
solutions.ur: UPS ko maintenance bypass par rakhein, EPO terminal pair voltage maarein; normal chalne par woh open hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Reset the EPO breaker, then press any front-panel button once to acknowledge and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: EPO breaker reset karein, phir front panel ka koi bhi button aik baar dabayein taake alarm clear ho.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A80E Overload: load 105% se zyada

meaning.en: The connected load is above 105% of the UPS rated output, so an overload fault is imminent.
meaning.ur: Connected load UPS rated output ke 105% se zyada hai, is liye overload fault ka khatra hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment connected, or load was added without resizing the UPS.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai, ya UPS resize kiye baghair load barha diya gaya hai.

causes.en: A single large motor or compressor with high inrush current on the output.
causes.ur: Output par koi aik bada motor ya compressor hai jis ka inrush current bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output loads before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle UPS band karein aur output loads disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current on each phase with a clamp meter; it must be below the rated output current.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka output current maarein; woh rated output current se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Remove non-essential loads one at a time until the load percentage on the display drops below 100%.
solutions.ur: Display par load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak ek aik karke ghair zaroori loads nikaalte jayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A810 Load % user threshold se upar

meaning.en: The load percentage has crossed the user-configured warning threshold, before the hard overload limit.
meaning.ur: Load percentage ne user-configured warning threshold cross kar liya hai, hard overload limit se pehle hi.

causes.en: The user-configured load warning threshold has been reached by normal growth of the load.
causes.ur: Normal load badhne se user-configured load warning threshold reach ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Non-essential equipment was left connected on the output.
causes.ur: Output par ghair zaroori equipment chhoda gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and compare it with the UPS kVA rating on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage parhein aur UPS kVA rating ke saath nameplate se compare karein.

solutions.en: Raise or lower the threshold in the User Settings menu if the site genuinely runs at this load.
solutions.ur: Agar site asal mein isi load par chalta hai to User Settings menu mein threshold barha ya gira dein.

solutions.en: Plan an upgrade to the next kVA size before the threshold becomes a hard overload.
solutions.ur: Threshold hard overload banne se pehle agle kVA size par upgrade ka plan banayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.en: A60D Batteries missing / box not connected
title.ur: A60D Batteries missing ya battery box connect nahi

meaning.en: The UPS cannot see its internal battery string or the external battery box; backup time is not available.
meaning.ur: UPS ko apni internal battery string ya external battery box nazar nahi aa rahi; backup time maujood nahi.

causes.en: The battery box is not inserted or its connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: Battery box insert nahi hai ya us ka connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery connector or harness is loose, corroded, or broken.
causes.ur: Battery connector ya harness dhila, zang khaa ya toota hua hai.

causes.en: The external battery breaker on the battery cabinet is open.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka external battery breaker khula hua hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off, unplug the mains, then use insulated tools and gloves.
solutions.ur: Load ko bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, phir insulated tools aur gloves use karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery box connector and the battery harness for loose, bent or corroded pins.
solutions.ur: Battery box connector aur battery harness ke pins ko dhile, tute ya zang khaye hue hone ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage across the battery box terminals with a DMM; 240 Vdc nominal (180 Vdc for 1-3kVA units) is expected.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery box terminals par DC voltage maarein; 240 Vdc nominal (1-3kVA par 180 Vdc) hona chahiye.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A802 Low battery (battery kam ho gayi)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery discharge and the battery has reached its low-charge warning level.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par chal raha hai aur battery low-charge warning level par aa chuki hai.

causes.en: The mains has failed and the UPS is running down its stored charge.
causes.ur: Mains chala gaya hai aur UPS apna stored charge khatam kar raha hai.

causes.en: The battery string has aged and no longer holds its rated capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur rated capacity nahi rakh sakti.

solutions.en: Save your work and shut down non-essential equipment immediately, before the UPS cuts out.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur UPS band hone se pehle ghair zaroori equipment foran band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level from the LCD or the backlit button panel.
solutions.ur: LCD ya backlit button panel se baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein.

solutions.en: Once mains returns, let the UPS charge on utility for at least 8 hours (48 h for a full runtime check).
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par UPS ko kam az kam 8 ghante (poori runtime check ke liye 48 ghante) utility par charge karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: AC20 Manual Bypass mode chal raha hai

meaning.en: The UPS has been commanded into manual bypass, so the load is on the raw bypass supply and is not protected.
meaning.ur: UPS ko manual bypass par command diya gaya hai, is liye load raw bypass supply par hai aur protected nahi.

causes.en: A technician placed the unit in manual bypass for maintenance work and left it there.
causes.ur: Kisi technician ne maintenance ke liye unit ko manual bypass par rakha aur wapas nahi kiya.

causes.en: The static switch latched into bypass after a previous overload or fault.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overload ya fault ke baad static switch bypass par latch ho gaya.

solutions.en: Confirm on the mimic screen whether the unit was deliberately put into bypass for maintenance.
solutions.ur: Mimic screen par check karein ke unit ko maintenance ke liye jaanbujh kar bypass kiya gaya tha ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the load is fully transferred and stable on bypass, then use the Controls menu to return the UPS to Normal mode.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke load poori tarah bypass par transfer ho chuka hai aur stable hai, phir Controls menu se UPS ko Normal mode par laayein.

solutions.en: Read the Event log to see which alarm or command sent the unit to bypass, and fix that cause.
solutions.ur: Event log parhein ke kaunsa alarm ya command unit ko bypass par le gaya, aur us wajah ko theek karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: A900 Maintenance bypass active hai

meaning.en: The rear maintenance bypass switch is closed, so the load is bypassing the UPS completely and gets no protection.
meaning.ur: Peeche maintenance bypass switch band hai, is liye load poora bypass ho raha hai aur UPS se koi protection nahi mil rahi.

causes.en: The manual bypass switch at the back of the cabinet was closed for servicing.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke peeche wala manual bypass switch servicing ke liye band kar diya gaya tha.

causes.en: The switch was left closed after maintenance and the UPS was never returned to Normal.
causes.ur: Maintenance ke baad switch band reh gaya aur UPS kabhi Normal par wapas nahi aaya.

solutions.en: Open the maintenance bypass switch at the back of the UPS to take the unit out of maintenance bypass.
solutions.ur: Upar ke masle ko hal karne ke liye UPS ke peeche wala maintenance bypass switch khol dein.

solutions.en: With the switch open, press any control-panel button to acknowledge and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Switch kholne ke baad alarm acknowledge aur clear karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi button dabayein.

solutions.en: Verify the Normal status indicator is on and the load is again fed through the power module.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Normal status indicator on hai aur load dobara power module se aa raha hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.en: A004 UPS overtemperature (alarm half of A004/F004)
title.ur: A004 UPS zyada garm (A004/F004 ka alarm hissa)

meaning.en: Alarm half of the over-temperature pair. The internal temperature is above the warning level; F004 is the fault that follows it.
meaning.ur: Over-temperature pair ka alarm hissa. Andar ka temperature warning level se upar hai; iske baad F004 fault aata hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature around the UPS exceeds 40 degrees C.
causes.ur: UPS ke aas paas ka ambient temperature 40 degree C se zyada hai.

causes.en: Intake or exhaust vents are blocked by dust or stacked equipment.
causes.ur: Intake ya exhaust vents dhool se ya upar rakhi cheezon se band hain.

causes.en: A cooling fan has failed and heat is building inside the cabinet.
causes.ur: Koi cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai aur cabinet ke andar garmi jama ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; the manual requires it to not exceed 40 degrees C.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; manual ke mutabiq ye 40 degree C se zyada na ho.

solutions.en: Clear the vents and remove any heat sources or equipment stacked on the unit.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur unit ke upar rakhi koi bhi cheez ya heat source hata dein.

solutions.en: Restart the UPS and confirm A004 no longer appears; if it returns, check the fan and the inverter NTC sensor.
solutions.ur: UPS restart karein aur confirm karein ke A004 dobara nahi aaya; agar wapas aaye to fan aur inverter NTC sensor check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F002 UPS Fault (aam khami)

meaning.en: General internal UPS fault. The inverter is off and the load has been thrown to the bypass line.
meaning.ur: Aam internal UPS fault. Inverter band hai aur load bypass line par daal diya gaya hai.

causes.en: An internal power-stage, control or sensing failure detected by the self-diagnosis.
causes.ur: Self-diagnosis ne andar ka power stage, control ya sensing ka kharabi detect ki.

causes.en: Often follows an earlier over-temperature, overload or DC bus fault that was not repaired.
causes.ur: Aksar is se pehle over-temperature, overload ya DC bus ka aisa fault aaya tha jo theek nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: If possible disconnect the power to the load, switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Ho sake to load ki power disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Open the Event log and Fault log to read which preceding alarm led to F002.
solutions.ur: Event log aur Fault log kholein aur parhein ke kaunsa pehla alarm F002 ki wajah bana.

solutions.en: If the problem occurs again after the restart, call the Eaton support centre with the serial number.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad masla dobara aaye to serial number le kar Eaton support centre ko call karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F004 Dissipator zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The power-stage heatsink is over temperature. The inverter is switched off and the load runs on bypass.
meaning.ur: Power stage ka heatsink zyada garm ho gaya hai. Inverter band ho gaya hai aur load bypass par chal raha hai.

causes.en: The environment temperature around the UPS is above 40 degrees C.
causes.ur: UPS ke gird ka environment temperature 40 degree C se zyada hai.

causes.en: A cooling fan has stopped or is blocked, so heat cannot leave the cabinet.
causes.ur: Koi cooling fan band ho gaya ya block ho gaya hai, is liye cabinet se garmi nahi nikal sakti.

solutions.en: Check that the temperature of the environment in which the UPS is located does not exceed 40 degrees C.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke jis environment mein UPS lagi hai uska temperature 40 degree C se zyada na ho.

solutions.en: Check that the fan is working normally first, then check the inverter NTC is not damaged.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke fan theek chal raha hai, phir inverter NTC damage na hua ho.

solutions.en: Clear the vents, give the unit airflow, then restart only after the temperature has dropped.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein, unit ko hawa ka raasta dein, phir temperature girne ke baad hi restart karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F300 Capacitor bank overvoltage (DC bus zyada wala)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor bank has charged above its safe limit, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka capacitor bank apni safe limit se upar charge ho gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: Charger output voltage is out of specification and is over-charging the bus.
causes.ur: Charger ka output voltage specification se bahar hai aur bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing or the rectifier control loop is faulty.
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing ya rectifier control loop kharab hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off and isolate mains and the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein aur koi bhi voltage naapne se pehle mains aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery string voltage with a DMM; an over-charged string reads well above its nominal value.
solutions.ur: DMM se har battery string ka voltage maarein; zyada charge hui string nominal se kaafi upar parhengi.

solutions.en: Have the charger output and rectifier board checked by an Eaton service engineer; do not simply reset F300.
solutions.ur: Charger output aur rectifier board ki jaanch Eaton service engineer se karwayein; F300 ko sirf reset na karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F301 Capacitor bank overvoltage (DC bus zyada wala)

meaning.en: Second over-voltage variant of the DC capacitor bank fault on the same bus; inverter is off, load on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC capacitor bank ke over-voltage fault ka doosra variant isi bus par; inverter band, load bypass par.

causes.en: A transient or unstable utility feed pushed the DC bus above its limit.
causes.ur: Mains feed ka koi transient ya instability ne DC bus ko limit se upar le diya.

causes.en: Bulk capacitor has failed short or drifted out of tolerance.
causes.ur: Bulk capacitor short ho gaya ya tolerance se bahar chala gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage with a rated DMM.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir rated DMM se DC bus voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Check the input voltage at the UPS terminal block is inside the manual's allowed range.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke UPS terminal block par input voltage manual ki ijazat ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Escalate to Eaton service for bulk capacitor and rectifier inspection.
solutions.ur: Bulk capacitor aur rectifier ki jaanch ke liye Eaton service ko bulayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F302 Capacitor bank undervoltage (DC bus kam wala)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor bank has not reached its minimum operating voltage, so the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka capacitor bank apni minimum operating voltage tak nahi pohanch chuka, is liye inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Input AC is missing or out of range, so the rectifier cannot charge the bus.
causes.ur: Input AC missing ya range se bahar hai, is liye rectifier bus charge nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: The pre-charge or soft-start path is open, so the capacitors never take charge.
causes.ur: Pre-charge ya soft-start path khula hai, is liye capacitors kabhi charge nahi hote.

solutions.en: Measure the input line-to-neutral voltage at the input terminal block with a DMM while the UPS is off.
solutions.ur: UPS band karte hue DMM se input terminal block par line-to-neutral voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Check the input breaker, fuses and the pre-charge contactor are closed and energised.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke input breaker, fuses aur pre-charge contactor band aur energised hain.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle repeatedly; book an Eaton technician to check the pre-charge circuit and capacitors.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; Eaton technician se pre-charge circuit aur capacitors check karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F303 Capacitor bank undervoltage (DC bus kam wala)

meaning.en: Second under-voltage variant of the DC capacitor bank fault; the inverter cannot start and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC capacitor bank ke under-voltage fault ka doosra variant; inverter start nahi ho sakta aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Battery string disconnected or open, so there is no DC source to charge the bus.
causes.ur: Battery string disconnect ya khuli hai, is liye bus ko charge karne ke liye koi DC source nahi.

causes.en: Input voltage persistently low, below the rectifier's working minimum.
causes.ur: Input voltage lagatar kam hai, rectifier ke minimum working voltage se neeche.

solutions.en: Check the battery string is connected and measure its open-circuit voltage with a DMM.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery string lagi hui hai aur DMM se us ka open-circuit voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Verify the external battery cabinet breaker is closed and the battery fuses are intact.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke external battery cabinet ka breaker band hai aur battery fuses salamat hain.

solutions.en: Have the rectifier and bus sensing checked by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Rectifier aur bus sensing ki jaanch Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F304 Unbalanced capacitor bank (DC bus asammulnot)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor voltages are not balanced within tolerance; the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus ke capacitor voltages tolerance ke andar balance nahi hain; inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: One or more bus capacitors has degraded, lost capacitance or leaked.
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada bus capacitors degrade ho gaya, capacity khoyi ya leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage balancing/sensing circuit has drifted.
causes.ur: Bus voltage balancing/sensing circuit drift ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery first, then measure each bus capacitor's voltage with a DMM and compare them.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DMM se har bus capacitor ka voltage maarein aur tulna karein.

solutions.en: Any capacitor reading far from the others must be replaced as a matched set, not individually.
solutions.ur: Doosron se bohat alag parhne wala capacitor matched set ke taur par replace karein, akela nahi.

solutions.en: Book an Eaton service engineer for bus capacitor replacement and balancing check.
solutions.ur: Bus capacitor ki tabdeeli aur balancing check ke liye Eaton service engineer bulaayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.en: F305 Failed capacitor bank soft start
title.ur: F305 Capacitor bank ka soft start fail

meaning.en: The soft-start circuit could not charge the capacitor bank smoothly at power-up, so the inverter stays off.
meaning.ur: Soft-start circuit ne power-up par capacitor bank ko smoothly charge nahi kar paaya, is liye inverter band reh gaya.

causes.en: Bus capacitors are aged or shorted, so the soft-start ramp cannot complete.
causes.ur: Bus capacitors purane ya short ho chuke hain, is liye soft-start ramp poora nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Soft-start thyristor or its gate drive has failed.
causes.ur: Soft-start thyristor ya us ka gate drive kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off, isolate mains and the battery.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein, mains aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check each bank fuse and the pre-charge resistor chain for continuity and heat damage.
solutions.ur: Har bank fuse aur pre-charge resistor chain ki continuity aur garmi ke nishan check karein.

solutions.en: Have the soft-start circuit and bus capacitors replaced by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Soft-start circuit aur bus capacitors ki tabdeeli Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F70C Inverter undervoltage (inverter voltage kam)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has dropped below its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat ke neeche gir gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: DC bus voltage is too low because the battery or charger is not supplying enough.
causes.ur: DC bus voltage kam hai kyunke battery ya charger itna supply nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Output is overloaded or the output voltage setting is set too low for the load.
causes.ur: Output overloaded hai ya output voltage setting load ke liye bohat kam rakhi gayi hai.

causes.en: Inverter output voltage sensing or the inverter board itself has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage sensing ya inverter board khud kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Reduce or remove the load first, then restart the UPS and see if F70C clears.
solutions.ur: Pehle load kam karein ya hata dein, phir UPS restart karke dekhein ke F70C clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus voltage with a DMM (isolate mains and battery first) and compare it with the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DMM se DC bus voltage maarein aur manual ki specification se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual output voltage at the output terminal block with a true-RMS DMM while on battery.
solutions.ur: Battery par chalte waqt true-RMS DMM se output terminal block par asal output voltage maarein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F70D Inverter overvoltage (inverter voltage zyada)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has risen above its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat se upar chala gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: Output voltage setting or the feedback potentiometer is misadjusted.
causes.ur: Output voltage setting ya feedback potentiometer ki adjustment ghalat hai.

causes.en: Output is very lightly loaded, so the inverter steps the voltage up.
causes.ur: Output bohat kam load par hai, is liye inverter voltage barha deta hai.

causes.en: Inverter board or output voltage sensing failure.
causes.ur: Inverter board ya output voltage sensing ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Read the configured output voltage in the Setup menu and confirm it matches the load's requirement.
solutions.ur: Setup menu se configured output voltage parhein aur confirm karein ke woh load ki requirement se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a true-RMS DMM at the output terminal block.
solutions.ur: True-RMS DMM se output terminal block par output voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Have the inverter board and output sensing calibrated by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Inverter board aur output sensing ki calibration Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F704 Inverter ka soft start fail

meaning.en: The inverter could not complete its soft-start ramp to operating voltage, so the UPS stays off the line and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: Inverter apna soft-start ramp operating voltage tak poora nahi kar paya, is liye UPS line par nahi aaya aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: DC bus voltage was not within range when the inverter was asked to start.
causes.ur: Inverter ko start karne ke waqt DC bus voltage range mein nahi tha.

causes.en: Inverter IGBT module or its gate drive has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter IGBT module ya us ka gate drive kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Output is short-circuited or heavily overloaded, so the ramp cannot be completed.
causes.ur: Output short ya bohat zyada overloaded hai, is liye ramp poora nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: If possible disconnect the power to the load, switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Ho sake to load ki power disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure the DC bus voltage and check for a short across the output.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DC bus voltage maarein aur output par short check karein.

solutions.en: If the problem occurs again, call the support centre - the inverter module needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar masla dobara aaye to support centre ko call karein - inverter module ki servicing zaroori hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F805 Short circuit (output short)

meaning.en: A short circuit exists on the UPS output. There is a fault on one or more of the loads powered by the UPS.
meaning.ur: UPS output par short circuit hai. UPS se power lene walay loads mein kisi aik ya zyada par fault hai.

causes.en: A connected load, adaptor or power strip has failed short.
causes.ur: Koi connected load, adaptor ya power strip short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched output wiring is touching the chassis earth.
causes.ur: Damage ya pinch hua output wiring chassis earth ko chhu raha hai.

causes.en: Output breaker or a downstream distribution board breaker is closed onto a shorted circuit.
causes.ur: Output breaker ya koi downstream distribution board ka breaker short circuit par band hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect all output loads before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wiring ko chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur saare output loads disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all the utilities, switch the UPS off and back on again, reconnect the loads one at a time to identify which one is faulty.
solutions.ur: Saari utilities disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein, phir loads aik aik karke dobara lagayein taake pata chale kaunsa kharab hai.

solutions.en: Use a DMM continuity/insulation check on each suspect load and cable before reconnecting it.
solutions.ur: Dohosne se pehle har shakhs load aur cable par DMM se continuity/insulation check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F808 Output overload fault (load zyada)

meaning.en: The load applied to the UPS is too high. The overload has progressed from alarm to fault and the inverter is off.
meaning.ur: UPS par lagaya hua load bohat zyada hai. Overload alarm se fault tak pohanch gaya hai aur inverter band hai.

causes.en: The load is too high for the UPS capacity; A80E/A810 were ignored earlier.
causes.ur: Load UPS ki capacity se zyada hai; A80E/A810 pehle ignore kar diye gaye the.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor with high inrush was switched on while on battery.
causes.ur: Battery chalte waqt koi bada motor ya compressor high inrush ke saath on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Remove the load and switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Load hata dein aur UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load to within the threshold of 100% (or the user threshold in the case of code A80E).
solutions.ur: Load ko 100% threshold ke andar laayein (code A80E ke haal mein user threshold tak).

solutions.en: Size the load with a clamp meter and move permanent load to a larger UPS or an external bypass-fed outlet.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naaphein aur mustaqil load ko barhe UPS ya external bypass-fed outlet par le jaayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

title.ur: F811 Negative output power (output power ulti)

meaning.en: The UPS measured power flowing backwards out of the output; the inverter has been shut down to protect the load.
meaning.ur: UPS ne output se power ulti taraf jaate hue naape hain; load bachane ke liye inverter band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Another source is feeding back into the UPS output, e.g. a generator or another UPS in parallel that is not synchronised.
causes.ur: Koi doosra source UPS output mein wapas power bhej raha hai, maslan generator ya doosra parallel UPS jo sync nahi hai.

causes.en: Output current direction sensing or the output current transformer is faulty.
causes.ur: Output current direction sensing ya output current transformer kharab hai.

causes.en: A generator or solar inverter changeover board is wired without an anti-backfeed device.
causes.ur: Generator ya solar inverter ka changeover board anti-backfeed device ke baghair jora gaya hai.

solutions.en: Remove all other sources feeding the output bus and confirm only the UPS and bypass feed the output.
solutions.ur: Output bus ko chalane walay saare doosre sources hata dein aur confirm karein ke sirf UPS aur bypass output ko feed kar rahe hain.

solutions.en: With a clamp meter, check the direction of current in each output conductor.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har output conductor mein current ki direction check karein.

solutions.en: Install an anti-backfeed relay or correct the changeover interlock, then have the output sensing checked.
solutions.ur: Anti-backfeed relay lagayein ya changeover interlock theek karein, phir output sensing check karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)
